쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요. 직무 소개 우리는 주어진 VALIDATION & TESTING - Support component and system-level validation, including vibration, structural, and environmental testing. - Support in validation, durability, and abuse testing activities to ensure performance and reliability. - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for mechanical performance issues. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE - B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related field. - 7+ years of experience in mechanical or product design for structural systems (battery structures preferred; body structures also applicable). - Strong understanding of mechanical loads, materials behavior, and product lifecycle considerations. - Experience with CAD tools (e.g., CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, or similar). - Familiarity with mechanical FEA too
